title: career.job.applied.v1
description: Producer: Careers. A public applicant's intake finished: the candidate is recorded and the Pipeline application exists (RCU-CAR-002/004). The applicant has no user id; reach them through candidateId.

jobId.description: The careers posting id, e.g. post-2026-0156.

possibleDuplicate.description: True when the applicant matched a candidate already on file (RCU-CND-002).

consents.description: Wording versions of the consents given on the form.
